metas.name: ★ 4.8 · 2026 · Crawlers
metas.description: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
metas.description: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Tu Hai Meri Kiran
metas.description: What starts as a real connection for her turns into his all-consuming obsession. As love darkens, the boundary between devotion and danger fades.

metas.name: 2026 · Nocturne
metas.description: Ex-soldier Jonah Lynn leaves Philadelphia for a quiet life. When serial killer Jurek Walter threatens his new home and family, Jonah must protect them, even as he sends his FBI agent daughter Saga to track the killer's last victim.
